files.what: Sprite pak ABS.pak, decrypted by this project from sprites/korea-2024/ABS.pak

version.basis: same as the encrypted pak it was decrypted from

region.basis: same as the encrypted pak it was decrypted from

files.notes: Made by this project, not shipped by any official source: the encrypted Korean pak decrypted into the plain 1999 PAK format that PAKLib reads. Decryption: XOR with the repeating key 4c b2 3e 1a from offset 20, the key restarting at each sprite; within a sprite, the 100-byte header, the frame table and the bitmap are each running-XORed (byte[i] ^= byte[i-4], restarting per region), except the frame count and the colour-key field. Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there). The decrypted bytes are identical to sprites/3.0/ABS.pak, so they are not stored a second time.

Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there).

files.notes: Made by this project, not shipped by any official source: the encrypted Korean pak decrypted into the plain 1999 PAK format that PAKLib reads. Decryption: XOR with the repeating key 4c b2 3e 1a from offset 20, the key restarting at each sprite; within a sprite, the 100-byte header, the frame table and the bitmap are each running-XORed (byte[i] ^= byte[i-4], restarting per region), except the frame count and the colour-key field. Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there).

Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there). Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there). Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there). Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there). The decrypted bytes are identical to sprites/3.0/WLeggings.pak, so they are not stored a second time.

region.basis: same as the encrypted pak it was decrypted from

files.notes: Made by this project, not shipped by any official source: the encrypted Korean pak decrypted into the plain 1999 PAK format that PAKLib reads. Decryption: XOR with the repeating key 4c b2 3e 1a from offset 20, the key restarting at each sprite; within a sprite, the 100-byte header, the frame table and the bitmap are each running-XORed (byte[i] ^= byte[i-4], restarting per region), except the frame count and the colour-key field. Restored bytes: BMP header bytes 12-17, a lost 'BM' signature in some paks, and the last 2 bytes of 4-aligned bitmaps set to 00 00 (inferred: every 1999 4-aligned bitmap, 9,675 of them, has 00 00 there).
